newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall slightly at auction.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices fell slightly on lack of demand from Afghanistan and Pakistan, brokers said.

Brokers said Pakistani buyers were less active after the sharp devaluation of the country's currency last week. Only Poland operated actively, lifting bold and large brokens. Russia also lent useful support to the market, they said.
More than 927,100 kg of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 43.99 taka, down 0.05 from the previous sale.
The next auction will be held on November 5 with an offer of 1.17 million kg. --Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
